title: PROFINET: Fixes for PROFIsafe subdissector
description:
Fixes for the PROFIsafe part of the PROFINET dissector.

1. PROFIsafe trailer length depends on CRC length (3 or 4 byte CRCs) not on the F_CRC_Seed value
2. PROFIsafe ipar_crc (32-bit value) displaying was truncated to 16-bit
3. Using the raw on-the-wire bytes for the PROFIsafe PRM flags instead of tightly coupling them to the hf_pn_io_ps_f_prm_* bitfield definitions

AI-Assisted: yes \[GH Copilot\]
